summary: A dashed GRID or SUB chip said “No mapped feature found for this project”, which asserts a search that ran and failed. 3,047 of the 7,680 records in this cut carry a grid measurement; the payload’s own coverage block records no_circuit: 0, so not one of the 4,633 dashed rows was measured and came up empty. The chip now separates the two silences it had been merging: 4,605 rows have a register coordinate and were not measured, and 28 have no coordinate to measure from.
modification_note: Replaces one hover string on the dashed GRID and SUB chips with two, chosen by the row’s own geometry_status. No payload, no new asset, no render-time network call, and no change to any chip that carries a number. The mapped-layer caveat (“Absence from a mapped layer is not absence on the ground”) is removed from the dash and left verbatim everywhere it belongs: it qualifies a distance measured against an incomplete layer, and a dashed row has no distance to qualify.

app.label: the dash says which silence it is, and stops asserting a failed search
GRID hands the chip the fact the row already holds
SUB hands the chip the same fact

registry_entry.mutates_existing_dashboard: the hover text of a dashed GRID or SUB chip
registry_entry.rule: A dash reports the absence of a measurement. It may not report the result of one. Where two different absences share a cell, the cell names which one it is from a fact the record already carries — geometry_status — and never from a guess about why the number is missing.
registry_entry.found_by: Counted on releases/202609032251-pipelinenews on 2026-09-04, from the release’s own shipped files. data/202608270055-8ab1807551bc-v8-fast-projects.json carries 7,680 rows; 7,652 have latitude and longitude and 28 do not (geometry_status missing 26, invalid 2). The grid index in data/202608311800-grid-distance.json holds 3,047 refs and the substation index in data/202608311858-substation-33kv.json holds the same 3,047. Every one of the 3,047 has a coordinate; not one coordinate-less record is in either index. That leaves 4,633 dashed rows, 4,605 of them with a usable coordinate. The grid-distance payload’s coverage block reads with_circuit 3,047, no_circuit 0, and its own note already said the truth the chip did not: “A project with no entry has no mapped circuit found, OR no coordinate in the register.”
registry_entry.upstream: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database Q2 2026 (OGL v3.0) for the register coordinate and its geometry_status; the release’s own data/202608311800-grid-distance.json coverage block for with_circuit and no_circuit.
